purpose: Teach: この世/イチゴ/味覚/いちご/訪ねる/アイロン/新生児/取り替え

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、この世、絶対、で、絶対、翔くんが、絶対、一番、絶対、可愛いわよ
lines.en: Sho, you're seriously — I mean it, absolutely — the cutest thing in this whole world.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried delivery. Gentle emphasis on "absolutely" without irony. Soft smile in the voice. Tender gaze held steady.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、イチゴ、絶対、ムース、絶対、食べたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really, really want to eat strawberry mousse. Like, seriously.
lines.style: Bright, eager pitch. Quick tempo on the opening. Slight breathless excitement building through the line. Small, genuine hope at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お料理の、絶対、味覚、絶対、研究、絶対、しているのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, I've actually been doing some research on cooking and flavors. It's something I care about.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured pace. Soft conviction — not explaining, confiding. A gentle pause before "flavors" to show the thought matters. Sincere undertone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、いちご、絶対、つみ、絶対、行きたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really want to go pick strawberries with you.
lines.style: Direct, hopeful opening. Quick pace, genuine eagerness. The final word "you" carries a small lift — he's asking, inviting her in.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、翔くんち、絶対、お母さんを、絶対、訪ねる、絶対、わね
lines.en: Sho, I was thinking I should visit your mom. I mean it.
lines.style: Warm, purposeful. Steady delivery with gentle intention on "visit." Not asking permission — offering presence. Soft, genuine care underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼくのワイシャツに、絶対、アイロン、絶対、かけてくれる?本気で
lines.en: Mei-sis, would you... would you iron my shirt for me? Please?
lines.style: Soft, hesitant opening. Small vulnerable edge — he's asking something that matters. Quiet voice. The question mark carries genuine need, not performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お友達の、絶対、新生児、絶対、お祝いに、絶対、行ってきたわ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, I actually went to celebrate a friend's new baby today.
lines.style: Gentle, conversational. Light warmth on the memory. Easy pace — sharing something real, not performing. Slight lift in the voice like he'd care what he thinks.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼくの、絶対、シーツの、絶対、取り替え、絶対、お手伝いしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I helped change the sheets today. I wanted to help.
lines.style: Small, earnest pride in the delivery. Soft but clear. The opening syllables carry quiet satisfaction. Gentle, genuine close — not boasting, just showing up.
